change: Static module import and re-export traversal for inline and linked module scripts
scope: Module specifiers resolve against the module response URL, including redirects
Ordinary asset assignments retain the including document base
Cycles use visited URL and script-kind identities
Shared 32-script, 8 MiB and page-time budgets remain in effect
limitations: Static lexical subset, not a complete ECMAScript parser
Scanning stops at interpolated template literals; later declarations may be missed
Import maps and dynamic imports remain unsupported
Offline module import rewriting and browser execution remain unimplemented or unverified
